heroHeading: Foot care in the comfort of your own home
heroText: A qualified podiatrist visiting homes across Glasgow East. No travelling, no waiting rooms, and no rush. Just friendly, professional care at a time that suits you.
helpIntro: Everyday foot care and treatment, carried out safely and professionally in your own home.
calloutText: That is perfectly normal. Get in touch and describe what is bothering you, and we will let you know what would help before arranging a visit.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Call, email, or fill in the enquiry form. Tell us a little about what you need and where you live.

steps.title: We arrange a time
steps.text: We will agree a date and time that suits you, and confirm what the visit will involve and what it will cost.

steps.title: We come to you
steps.text: Everything needed is brought along. All you need is a comfortable chair and somewhere to rest your feet.

areasIntro: Home visits across Glasgow East and the surrounding areas.
areasNote: If your area is not listed, please still get in touch. We may be able to help or suggest someone who can.
